      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline objectives for the upcoming period">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan for strategic alignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Strategic_FinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Approve adjustment with necessary stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Strategic_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finance_AdjustmentDecision" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentNeeded" name="Adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_ImplementationBegun"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_ImplementationBegun"/>
